g.text: Architecture Note for use case 1 to 4:
Single RA Board runs the complete demonstration
Application simulates both parties (Decapsulator & Encapsulator, or Signer & Verifier)
PSA Crypto API manages all cryptographic operations
Network transfers are simulated in memory
Use Case 1: ML-KEM - Two-Party Key Exchange
(Both roles simulated on a RA Board)
Use Case 2: ML-KEM - Export/Import Keypair (Backup & Recovery)
Use Case 3: ML-DSA - Two-Party Signing & Verification
(Both roles simulated on a RA Board)
Use Case 4: ML-DSA - Export/Import Keypair (Backup & Recovery)
Use Case 5: ML-KEM - Decap & ML-DSA - Sign (Remote Verify)
RA MCU decapsulate, Host PC encapsulate
then RA MCU sign the share secret, Host PC verify
4: Use the public key to encapsulate
8: Notify both share secret are match
Loop with a condition specified in the note on the right.
Alternative fragment for conditional flow (if/else logic).
Optional fragment for a single conditional. Execute only if [condition] is true.
